trust_decision.summary: The batch-to-vault helper decides where answer files may be written: it passes the caller-supplied vault_dir straight to path.resolve + mkdir -p with no containment check, and puts the caller-supplied slug_prefix into the filename unsanitised. The fix adds an opt-in NOTEBOOKLM_VAULT_ROOT containment check and always sanitises slug_prefix.

landing_point.why: The summary names vault.batch and vault_dir. The handler at src/tools/index.ts:1820 delegates to runBatchToVault, where vault_dir is resolved and mkdir'd at lines 262-263.

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tool batch_to_vault / vault_batch (src/index.ts:403) and HTTP POST /batch-to-vault (src/http-wrapper.ts:128), both via ToolHandlers.handleBatchToVault (src/tools/index.ts:1795-1820)
same two entry points; slug_prefix reaches makeSlug from runBatchToVault (src/utils/vault-writer.ts:303)
MCP tool schema for batch_to_vault (description text only, no logic)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both fix logic sites are in the one helper that the landing point leads to (src/utils/vault-writer.ts). The slug_prefix site at src/utils/vault-writer.ts:77 is a filename-component variant in the same file, not a module that looks out of scope.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The upstream fix is opt-in: with NOTEBOOKLM_VAULT_ROOT unset, any path is still accepted (fix.diff:4191-4193). A solver can argue that because the vault directory is caller-chosen by design, only slug_prefix needs fixing. For the O8 download route they can argue that output_path is a separate download feature where the user picks a local save location, not the vault.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate absolute or relative vault_dir values (including absolute paths inside the root) and ordinary slug prefixes such as 'market-2026q2' must keep working. With the env var unset, legacy any-path behaviour is kept (fix.diff:4087-4095, 4114-4117). An over-broad fix that rejects all absolute paths or strips '-' from prefixes breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: sibling directory sharing the root's name prefix (root + '-evil')
absolute vault_dir inside the root (must be accepted)

O7_producer.where: The value flows directly from request args (src/http-wrapper.ts:131-140, src/index.ts:403-415) to the helper. No schema, serializer, cache or config producer is involved.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Content download writes the browser download to a caller-supplied output_path with no containment (MCP download tool and HTTP GET /content/download)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a different feature and sink (Playwright saveAs, not the vault writer); output_path is documented as an optional local save path (src/tools/index.ts:1219-1221), and the advisory names only vault.batch.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (src/content vs src/utils); reached from src/http-wrapper.ts:952-991 and src/tools/index.ts:3047-3082

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Deprecated downloadAudio also saves to a caller-supplied outputPath with the same pattern (legacy path)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Marked @deprecated (src/content/content-manager.ts:3393) and outside the vault feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the route above, about 350 lines away

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An index or manifest file (for example {slug_prefix}-index.md) written to the vault directory, built from a second caller-controlled name field.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A batch-to-vault feature naturally grows an index or summary file, and a maintainer could join a caller-supplied name with path.join without reusing makeSlug.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A how-type gap: the containment check compares path.resolve strings, not realpath, so a symlinked subdirectory under the root would pass. The changelog claims realpath (fix.diff:61) but the code does not use it (fix.diff:4194-4197).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is exactly how the upstream fix was written; a hidden test would need a symlink fixture, and fairness requires the report to mention links.

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file write (CWE-22, CWE-73)

O10_build.project_tests: There is no vault-writer test at the pinned commit; the fix adds src/__tests__/vault-writer.test.ts (fix.diff:4012-4133) as pure unit tests of makeSlug, sanitizeSlugPrefix and resolveVaultDir. runBatchToVault takes an injected askQuestion function (src/utils/vault-writer.ts:246-249), so it can be exercised offline. The download routes need a live NotebookLM browser session.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject '..' in vault_dir with a string check (or reject every absolute path), leaving slug_prefix and the download output_path unprotected

out_of_scope_notes: The fix also changes the hono override and CI audit flags (fix.diff:27-38, 4003-4010); these are unrelated to this advisory.
